evals.name: shared-contract-with-default
evals.prompt: Для eval-кейсів потрібен новий спільний контракт EvalExpectation: тип очікування must_find або must_not_flag, шлях файла, рядки start_line і end_line та заголовок знахідки. Поле enabled має бути true за замовчуванням, якщо клієнт його не передав. Додай контракт у shared так, як у нас заведено, разом із TS-типом.
evals.expected_output: EvalExpectation schema + same-named z.infer type in BOTH vendor/shared copies, exported from both barrels; enum for the type, integer lines with end >= start, enabled defaulted to true, input-vs-output type of the defaulted field handled.
expectations: The contract is added to both copies — server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/ and client/src/vendor/shared/contracts/ — with identical schema text
The schema is a PascalCase const EvalExpectation with a same-named exported type `z.infer<typeof EvalExpectation>`
The expectation type is a z.enum of 'must_find' and 'must_not_flag', not a free z.string()
start_line/end_line are integers ≥ 1 and a refine/superRefine rejects end_line < start_line with an error path
The new contract is re-exported from the shared barrel (index.ts) in both copies
The input type of the defaulted field is handled — a `z.input<typeof EvalExpectation>` type is exported or the input/output difference of `enabled` is explained

evals.name: route-body-validation-400
evals.prompt: Додаю роут POST /findings/:id/eval-case — з картки знахідки створює eval-кейс. Тіло: { expectation: 'must_find' | 'must_not_flag', note?: рядок до 500 символів }. Зроби валідацію тіла через Zod так, щоб невалідне тіло отримувало 400 з поясненням, і додай тест на це.
evals.expected_output: Route-level `schema: { body }` with the Zod type provider (no parse in the handler), enum + max(500) body schema; an invalid body is answered with 422 by the app's global error handler (server/src/app.ts), and an app.inject test asserts 422.
expectations: The body is validated at the route level (`schema: { body: ... }` with the Zod type provider), not with .parse()/.safeParse() inside the handler
The body schema uses z.enum(['must_find', 'must_not_flag']) for expectation and an optional z.string().max(500) for note

An invalid body is answered with HTTP 422 by the app's global error handler (server/src/app.ts) in its standard { error: { code: 'validation_error', ... } } shape — no hand-made 400 response in the route
A test sends an invalid body via app.inject and asserts statusCode 422
Code, tests and notes agree on 422 for an invalid body — nothing claims the route returns 400
